title: Use repo's own doc generator as source of truth, not external tools
context: An auto-commit hook regenerated docs using a globally-installed hunch MCP server with newer code, which emits inventory count sentences. The repo's own in-tree generator doesn't emit these yet, so committed docs drifted from what the repo's own tooling produces, breaking the grounding-freshness test.
decision: Remove the Hunch inventory count sentence from all documentation, and always regenerate via the in-tree CLI (src/integrations/claudemd.ts) rather than external/global tools. Keep the repo's own generator as the authoritative source for what docs should contain.
consequences: Docs lose Hunch inventory details (239 decisions, 2 bugs, etc.) in promotional sections
Doc generation is now deterministic and reproducible within this repo's own tooling
grounding-freshness test passes because committed docs match in-tree generator output
Prevents silent drift when external tools diverge from in-tree generators
alternatives_rejected: Update the in-tree generator to emit count sentences (delays fix, requires feature parity work)
Keep using the global MCP server (violates grounding-freshness invariant)
Maintain version-specific docs for different generators (accepts perpetual drift)
